title: Diagnostics Hardware Report
description: Continuous physical host/disk SMART and I/O plus live Talos, Longhorn, VPA, Argo, application and backup diagnostics. No snapshot measurements.

options.content:
**Physical host / disk filters** control the hardware panels. **Talos node / namespace filters** control supported cluster panels. Click a disk in the inventory to focus its hardware readings.

Physical I/O comes from the host kernel. SMART comes from the drive through smartctl_exporter: **“Drive reports OK” is one test, not a clean bill of health.** Its current version can retain the previous SMART result after a failed device poll and exposes no last-successful-poll time. We hide drive results when the host, SMART exporter, or disk-presence telemetry disappears, but a responding exporter cannot prove a fresh device read. Missing readings remain **unknown**, never zero or healthy.

panels.title: 1 · Physical disks — live inventory, condition and I/O
Host collectors
panels.description: A down endpoint makes dependent readings unknown. The list includes configured but unreachable hosts.

panels.title: Disk activity collector
panels.description: An HTTP endpoint can respond while disk collection fails. Missing and failed collection are unknown hardware state.

panels.title: Connected physical drives · click a disk
panels.description: Live kernel/udev inventory. NVMe namespaces are grouped by controller for SMART correlation. Missing hosts remain visible in exporter availability above; they are not silently certified healthy.

panels.title: Drive self-check result
panels.description: SMART overall self-assessment, subject to the cached-result limitation above. Missing is unknown. A value of 1 can coexist with heavy wear, interface errors or latency.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_smart_status{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: Drive capacity
panels.description: Live SMART inventory and capacity; missing capacity is unknown, not a zero-byte disk.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_nvme_capacity_bytes{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"}>0 or smartctl_device_capacity_bytes{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"}>0)) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: Drive temperature
panels.description: Current temperature reported by SMART; cached-poll limitation applies.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_temperature{job="physical-smartctl",temperature_type="current",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: SSD life used (NVMe)
panels.description: NVMe estimate of rated write endurance used. It is not a countdown to a failure date;100% means the rated endurance estimate has been consumed. SATA vendor-specific wear values are in the raw attribute table; unsupported drives are unknown.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_percentage_used{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: NVMe media errors
panels.description: Cumulative media/data-integrity errors. Investigate increases; zero does not exclude other faults.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_media_errors{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: SAS errors and grown defects
panels.description: SAS lifetime grown defects and uncorrected read/write errors. Missing metrics mean unsupported or unavailable, not zero.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk,check)(label_replace({__name__=~"smartctl_scsi_grown_defect_list|smartctl_read_total_uncorrected_errors|smartctl_write_total_uncorrected_errors",job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"},"check","$1","__name__","(.*)"))) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: Drive powered-on time
panels.description: Lifetime power-on time reported by the drive; age alone is not a replacement verdict.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_power_on_seconds{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: NVMe critical warning flags
panels.description: NVMe warning bitmask; any nonzero value needs investigation. Unsupported devices show no telemetry.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device_critical_warning{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: SATA attributes · raw vendor values
panels.description: Raw attributes retain vendor names and IDs. Wear fields are not interchangeable across models; never interpret every field as percent remaining.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk,attribute_name,attribute_id)(smartctl_device_attribute{job="physical-smartctl",attribute_value_type="raw",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"})) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1)

panels.title: Connected drives missing SMART identity
panels.description: Present kernel disks without SMART identity need inspection: unsupported path, permissions, unavailable exporter or failed discovery. An empty result is good only if exporter availability and connected-drive inventory above are complete.

targets.expr: (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1)) unless on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(smartctl_device{job="physical-smartctl",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-smartctl"})==1))

panels.title: Physical disk reads
panels.description: Read traffic at the physical host kernel.

targets.expr: sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Physical disk writes
panels.description: Write traffic at the physical host kernel; ordinary backup traffic can be large.

targets.expr: sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Physical disk average queue
panels.description: Time-weighted outstanding I/O. NVMe namespaces are summed per controller; compare with completed-request delay.

targets.expr: sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Physical disk busy time
panels.description: Busiest namespace on each controller; this avoids summing parallel namespaces above 100%. Busy alone does not establish NVMe saturation.

targets.expr: 100 * max by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Physical read delay · average
panels.description: Total completed-request time divided by completed requests. No requests means no latency observation, not 0ms. This is an average, not a tail-latency measurement.

targets.expr: (1000 * sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))>0)) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Physical write delay · average
panels.description: Total completed-request time divided by completed requests. No requests means no latency observation, not 0ms. This is an average, not a tail-latency measurement.

targets.expr: (1000 * sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by(physical_host,disk)(rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]))>0)) and on(physical_host,disk) (max by(physical_host,disk)(node_disk_info{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",disk=~"${disk:regex}",device=~"sd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host) (max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="diskstats"})==1))

panels.title: Guest disk reads
panels.description: Talos virtual block devices. Resolve the selected VM device through the dated physical path before assigning SSD blame. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest disk writes
panels.description: Includes ordinary backup staging and application writes; a burst alone is not thrashing. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest disk average queue
panels.description: Average outstanding I/O from guest block accounting. This is not the physical Proxmox disk queue. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((rate(node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest disk busy time
panels.description: Guest busy percentage; NVMe parallelism means utilization alone does not establish saturation. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((100 * rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest read await — average
panels.description: Average completed guest read latency; not p99 and not a direct physical SSD measurement. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((1000 * rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]) / clamp_min(rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]),0.001)) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest write await — average
panels.description: Average completed guest write latency; compare with queue, workload and fsync. Only QEMU-backed guest disks are included; attached Longhorn iSCSI devices are excluded.

targets.expr: label_replace((((1000 * rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]) / clamp_min(rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device=~"sd[a-z]+|vd[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval]),0.001)) and on(instance,device) node_disk_info{model="QEMU_HARDDISK"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Slow-end etcd WAL flush delay
panels.description: Cluster-wide control-plane WAL histogram; not filtered by node/namespace. Inspect current values before recommending a disk. The estimate means 99 of 100 operations completed within this delay; it is not the average of the slowest 1%.

panels.title: Slow-end etcd database commit delay
panels.description: Cluster-wide etcd backend commit histogram. Keep separate from average block await. The estimate means 99 of 100 operations completed within this delay; it is not the average of the slowest 1%.

panels.title: 2 · Memory and CPU — physical hosts, guests and VPA
Physical CPU busy
panels.description: Includes host work and virtual machines; disk selection does not apply.

panels.title: Physical memory in use
panels.description: Host memory usage from Linux MemAvailable, not summed guest allocation. ZFS ARC can occupy much of NAS RAM; check memory pressure before treating high usage as a shortage.

panels.title: Physical memory pressure
panels.description: Host tasks stalled for memory. Local container limits can still thrash on an otherwise comfortable host.

panels.title: Physical I/O pressure
panels.description: Host tasks waiting on I/O. Correlate with physical disk queue and workloads.

panels.title: Filesystem space used
panels.description: Capacity unavailable to ordinary writers as a percentage of filesystem size, including reserved space. Host and mount point are live; mounted filesystems and ZFS datasets can share backing storage, so do not add their capacities. Virtual memory/overlay filesystems are excluded; missing or failed collection is unknown.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - max by(physical_host,mountpoint)(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|proc|sysfs|cgroup2?"}) / (max by(physical_host,mountpoint)(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|proc|sysfs|cgroup2?"})>0))) and on(physical_host)(max by(physical_host)(up{job="physical-node"})==1) and on(physical_host)(max by(physical_host)(node_scrape_collector_success{job="physical-node",collector="filesystem"})==1) and on(physical_host,mountpoint)(max by(physical_host,mountpoint)(node_filesystem_device_error{job="physical-node",physical_host=~"${physical_host:regex}",fstype!~"tmpfs|devtmpfs|overlay|squashfs|nsfs|proc|sysfs|cgroup2?"})==0)

panels.title: ZFS ARC cache in memory
panels.description: ARC is the ZFS read cache in host RAM, not application bloat. Compare cache size with memory pressure and available RAM before treating high NAS memory usage as a shortage. Hosts without ZFS show no cache series.

panels.title: Guest CPU busy
panels.description: Guest CPU execution; inspect steal separately for Proxmox contention.

targets.expr: label_replace(((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest memory in use
panels.description: Uses guest MemAvailable, not page-cache subtraction guesses.

targets.expr: label_replace(((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest CPU steal
panels.description: Time the VM wanted CPU while the hypervisor ran something else; physical host load is not exported.

targets.expr: label_replace(((100 * avg by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="steal"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) max by(instance,nodename) (node_uname_info{job!="physical-node",nodename=~"${node:regex}"})),"host","$1","nodename","talos-prod-cluster-v2-(.*)-(workers|planes)-[^-]+")

panels.title: Guest memory pressure
panels.description: OS memory PSI waiting; local container limits can thrash even when this stays low.

panels.title: CPU requests vs allocatable
panels.description: A=requests of selected namespaces from Running/Pending pods; B=whole-node allocatable. Scheduling requests are not measured utilization.

panels.title: Memory requests vs allocatable
panels.description: A=selected namespace requests from Running/Pending pods; B=whole-node allocatable.

panels.title: VPA in-place updates · selected time range
panels.description: Actual updater counter increments, not recommendation gauges. Namespace filter applies; node does not.

renameByName.Value: VPA in-place updates · selected time range

panels.title: VPA admissions actually applied · selected range
panels.description: Global counter filtered applied=true. This exporter has no target namespace label, so namespace/node filters do not apply.

panels.title: Application CPU footprint
panels.description: Current CPU cost by selected namespace and node; compare value and actual use before removing a monitoring stack.

panels.title: Application memory footprint
panels.description: Container working sets by namespace; excludes pod-parent/pause containers. This is not VM total or a justification to delete applications automatically.

panels.title: 3 · Spread and replicas — live placement and copy counts
Node readiness · 1 ready / 0 not ready
panels.description: All selected nodes from kube-state-metrics, including an unreachable exporter.

panels.title: Running pods per node
panels.description: Placement count, not proof replicas span physical hosts. Two VMs on one Proxmox host share that failure domain.

panels.title: Deployments missing ready replicas
panels.description: Zero is no missing availability; intentionally parked replicas=0 remain zero. Namespace filter only.

panels.title: StatefulSets missing ready replicas
panels.description: Desired minus Ready for StatefulSets. Namespace filter only.

panels.title: Longhorn robustness · count by state
panels.description: One-hot state series. Detached/unknown volumes are not automatically broken; cross-check attached state. Namespace filter uses PVC namespace; node filter omitted because replica location differs from engine placement.

panels.title: Longhorn attachment · count by state
panels.description: Backup staging can temporarily add volumes; detached retained/parked volumes can be expected.

panels.title: Longhorn configured copies
panels.description: Desired copies from the live Volume resource. A target of 1 intentionally provides no second Longhorn replica; backup protection is separate.

panels.title: Longhorn running copies
panels.description: Running replica processes are not necessarily in-sync. Detached/parked volumes can correctly have 0 running replicas. Replica metadata comes from each host manager; check manager/node availability.

panels.title: Longhorn in-sync writable copies
panels.description: RW is the attached engine’s replica mode. Detached volumes need not have an engine report; absent is not a measured 0. Compare configured copies, running copies and robustness.

panels.title: Live replica placement
panels.description: Maps writable Longhorn replicas to current Talos node and guest disk path. It does not infer which physical SSD backs a VM disk. VMs sharing one Proxmox machine share a failure domain.

panels.title: 4 · Disk thrashing — page rereads, stalls and maintenance
File-page refaults · busiest pods
panels.description: Maximum of pod-parent and child cgroups avoids summing overlapping accounting. Refaults alone need pressure/I/O correlation.

panels.title: Memory PSI · most affected pods
panels.description: Max across parent/child avoids double counting. No OOM kill is required for a reclaim storm.

panels.title: Container reads · busiest pods
panels.description: Container cgroup reads. Backup clones appear under Longhorn; compare time windows before diagnosing thrash.

panels.title: Guest I/O pressure
panels.description: Guest tasks stalled on I/O. Missing node data is an exporter/node availability gap.

panels.title: Temporal recovery · completed Job runtime
panels.description: Dedicated maintenance Job, unfiltered by namespace/node. Job-history retention limits visible old runs; completion is required, so active jobs do not masquerade as finished.

panels.title: DCGM scrape availability · 24h
panels.description: Dedicated GPU exporter, unfiltered by node/namespace. Uses the current exporter pod only, up to 24h of its samples; retired pre-repair pods are excluded. Not proof GPU workloads are healthy.

panels.title: 5 · Argo — synchronization and actual application health
Argo application sync states
panels.description: Selected destination namespaces. Synced means Git agrees; an app can still be broken.

panels.title: Argo application health states
panels.description: Application health is as strong as its probes and health rules. Node filter does not apply.

panels.title: Argo applications needing attention
panels.description: An empty result can mean no app matches these fault conditions; check the state panels above for telemetry coverage.

panels.title: Argo sync outcomes · selected time range
panels.description: Global sync outcomes, not an application uptime measure; this metric has no reliable destination-namespace selector.

renameByName.Value: Argo sync outcomes · selected time range

panels.title: Running but not Ready · ordinary pods
panels.description: Includes running pods on unreachable nodes: stale container readiness is not pod health. Completed jobs are excluded. Namespace filter only.

renameByName.Value: Running but not Ready · ordinary pods

panels.title: Pending pods · scheduling or attachment
panels.description: Empty is expected when none are Pending. A short backup staging pod is not automatically an application outage.

panels.title: Container restarts · selected time range
panels.description: Counters include multiple causes. Inspect termination reason/logs; 137 alone does not prove OOM.

panels.title: PVC used capacity · telemetry available
panels.description: Some crashing pods stop reporting volume stats. A missing PVC is unknown, not empty. See the missing-telemetry panel for claims absent from these measurements.

panels.title: Bound PVCs without usage telemetry
panels.description: Missing usage samples are unknown, not healthy. Includes crashing applications, parked/unmounted claims and storage drivers without volume-stat support. Crashing workloads can lose usage telemetry even when their volume is full. Namespace filter only.

panels.title: Time since last successful backup
panels.description: Newest successful snapshot timestamp per namespace/policy, not the oldest retained snapshot. Daily/hourly policies have different intended intervals.

panels.title: Latest backup outcome · 1 success / 0 failure
panels.description: Boolean status, not a timestamp. Ready schedules and historical successful snapshots can coexist with a failed latest run.

panels.title: 7 · What needs attention now — live signals and next checks
Firing alerts
panels.description: Current Prometheus firing alerts. Empty means no firing alert series, not proof that every fault is monitored. Alert coverage and physical exporter reachability matter.

panels.title: Use the readings to choose the repair

options.content:
- **Missing exporter or drive:** establish reachability and discovery before judging health. A missing reading is unknown.
- **SMART warning, increasing media errors, or worn endurance:** verify the model-specific evidence, protect the data, then plan replacement. A passing overall test does not erase these concerns.
- **Growing disk queues plus long request delays:** correlate physical-host pressure with guest and pod activity. High throughput alone can be healthy backup work.
- **Memory stalls and file-page rereads:** compare the application’s memory budget with VPA activity before blaming a disk.
- **One writable replica:** compare configured copies and physical failure domains before maintenance. Three pods on one physical host do not survive that host failing.
- **Argo synchronized but application unhealthy:** inspect readiness, logs and the actual user operation. Synchronization checks configuration, not recovery.
- **Full or unreported PVC, failed or stale backup:** inspect the backing pool and latest failure. A successful backup still needs an isolated restore check.

This dashboard is continuous telemetry. Replacement history, model-specific fit constraints and dated forensic findings remain in the [September inspection](https://mitchross.github.io/talos-argocd-proxmox/diagnostics/); they are not current measurements.
